answer: A concrete Sybil defense is stake-bonded identity admission: minting an identity requires locking a minimum bond held for the epoch and slashed on proven duplicate-key findings. The bond is charged per identity, not per action, so ten thousand puppets cost ten thousand frozen bonds before a reward arrives, making fleet profit negative once the bond exceeds reward times survival odds. Epoch-anchored reputation adds a wall: fresh keys start at zero weight and reach the zenith only after many honest epochs. An echo check flags wallets sharing funders, so a farm becomes one tundra of dead capital.
